description: This file contains utility functions related to shopping list entries, categories, and space limits, including visibility checks and limit comparisons.

methods.name: isEntryVisible
methods.description: Determines if a shopping list entry should be visible based on its delayed/checked state and device settings.

methods.name: isShoppingListFoodVisible
methods.description: Checks if any entries within a shopping list food item are visible.

methods.name: isDelayed
methods.description: Checks if a shopping list entry is delayed based on its delayUntil property.

methods.name: isShoppingListFoodDelayed
methods.description: Checks if any entry within a shopping list food item is delayed.

methods.name: isShoppingCategoryVisible
methods.description: Determines if a shopping category has any visible foods.

methods.name: isSpaceAboveLimit
methods.description: Checks if a space exceeds any configured limit (user, recipe, storage).

methods.name: isSpaceAboveUserLimit
methods.description: Checks if space exceeds the maximum number of users.

methods.name: isSpaceAboveRecipeLimit
methods.description: Checks if space exceeds the maximum number of recipes.

methods.name: isSpaceAtRecipeLimit
methods.description: Checks if space is at the recipe limit.

methods.name: isSpaceAboveStorageLimit
methods.description: Checks if space exceeds the maximum file storage limit.
